pages.quiz:
ARABIC — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

2. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.

3. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.

4. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.

5. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.

6. When practising Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Fluency.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Fluency: Pronunciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud: Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information: Visuals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
